content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Meters and utility metering software sold to water and gas utilities, matching ESCO's utility metering and data business model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Mainly industrial valves, pumps and composite panels for process plants; its aerospace share is only one segment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Roof coatings, sealants and HVAC components sold to construction contractors; different products and customers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Generic IoT connectivity routers and modules sold across many industries, not utility metering or power testing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors; it does not manufacture utility or test equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Smart electricity and gas meters, grid communication networks and utility software sold to utilities, closely matching ESCO's utility solutions."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors for industrial and rail customers; different products and buyers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Coatings, sealants and roofing systems sold to contractors and consumers; a building-materials business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and transit fare systems; overlaps only in utility customers, not the same products."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers for manufacturers plus water quality instruments; different products from ESCO's power testing and filtration."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Commercial plumbing fixtures and drinking-water filtration for building owners; different products and customers from ESCO."}]}
